positions.statement: On his campaign home page, Smith says a single adult working full time in Oregon needs $26.46 an hour to cover basic needs without public assistance.

positions.statement: On his campaign home page, Smith calls for a permanent moratorium on data centers and describes himself as the only anti data center candidate.
